paragraphs: Nvidia Corporation ( en-VID-ee-ə) is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The company develops graphics processing units (GPUs), systems on chips (SoCs), and application programming interfaces (APIs) for data science, high-performance computing, artificial intelligence (AI) hardware, and mobile and automotive applications. Founded in 1993 by Jensen Huang, Chris Malachowsky, and Curtis Priem, Nvidia has been described as a Big Tech company and is among the largest companies by market capitalization.

Originally focused on GPUs for video games, Nvidia broadened their usage into other markets, including AI, professional visualization, and supercomputing. The company's product lines include GeForce GPUs for gaming and creative workloads, and professional GPUs for edge computing, scientific research, and industrial applications. In 2025, Nvidia became the first company to surpass US$4 trillion and US$5 trillion in market capitalization, largely driven by the AI boom and soaring demand for its AI data center hardware.

people.name: Jen-Hsun Huang
people.title: President and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Co-founded NVIDIA in 1993 and has served as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a board member since inception. Previously worked at LSI Logic Corporation and as a microprocessor designer for AMD.
people.quote: Jen-Hsun Huang co-founded NVIDIA in 1993 and has served as our President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board of Directors since our inception.

people.name: Colette M. Kress
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Joined NVIDIA in 2013 as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer. Previously held finance leadership positions at Cisco Systems and Microsoft and finance positions at Texas Instruments.
people.quote: Colette M. Kress joined NVIDIA in 2013 as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer.

people.name: Ajay K. Puri
people.title: Executive Vice President, Worldwide Field Operations
people.bio: Joined NVIDIA in 2005 as Senior Vice President, Worldwide Sales and became Executive Vice President, Worldwide Field Operations in 2009. Previously held sales, marketing, and general management positions during a 22-year career at Sun Microsystems.
people.quote: Ajay K. Puri joined NVIDIA in 2005 as Senior Vice President, Worldwide Sales and became Executive Vice President, Worldwide Field Operations in 2009.

people.name: Debora Shoquist
people.title: Executive Vice President, Operations
people.bio: Joined NVIDIA in 2007 as Senior Vice President of Operations and became Executive Vice President of Operations in 2009. Previously served in executive roles at JDS Uniphase, Coherent, and Quantum.
people.quote: Debora Shoquist joined NVIDIA in 2007 as Senior Vice President of Operations and in 2009 became Executive Vice President of Operations.

people.name: Timothy S. Teter
people.title: Executive Vice President and General Counsel
people.bio: Joined NVIDIA in 2017 and became Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Secretary in February 2018. Previously spent more than two decades at Cooley LLP focusing on patent and technology-related litigation and worked as an engineer at Lockheed Missiles and Space Company.
people.quote: Timothy S. Teter joined NVIDIA in 2017 as Senior Vice President, General Counsel and Secretary

people.name: Tench Coxe
people.title: Director; Former Managing Director, Sutter Hill Ventures
people.bio: Was a Managing Director of Sutter Hill Ventures from 1989 to 2020, focusing on IT investments. Previously served as Director of Marketing and MIS at Digital Communication Associates.
people.quote: Tench Coxe was a Managing Director of Sutter Hill Ventures, a venture capital investment firm, from 1989 to 2020

people.name: John O. Dabiri
people.title: Director; Centennial Professor of Aeronautics and Mechanical Engineering, California Institute of Technology
people.bio: Heads the Dabiri Lab at the California Institute of Technology. Served as a professor at Stanford University from 2015 to 2019 and on President Biden's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology from 2021 to January 2025.
people.quote: John O. Dabiri is the Centennial Professor of Aeronautics and Mechanical Engineering at the California Institute of Technology.

people.name: Jen-Hsun Huang
people.title: President, Chief Executive Officer, and Director, NVIDIA Corporation
people.bio: Founded NVIDIA in 1993 and has served since its inception as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a Board member. Previously worked at LSI Logic and Advanced Micro Devices.
people.quote: Jen-Hsun Huang founded NVIDIA in 1993 and has served since its inception as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board.

people.name: Dawn Hudson
people.title: Director; Former Chief Marketing Officer, National Football League & Former CEO Pepsi-Cola North America
people.bio: Served as Chief Marketing Officer for the National Football League from 2014 to 2018 and Vice Chairman of The Parthenon Group from 2009 to 2014. Was President and Chief Executive Officer of Pepsi-Cola North America from 2005 to 2007.
people.quote: Dawn Hudson serves on the boards of various companies.

people.name: Melissa B. Lora
people.title: Director
people.bio: Held senior executive roles during a 31-year career at Taco Bell, including President of Taco Bell International at her retirement in 2018 and Global Chief Financial and Development Officer. Has served on Conagra Brands' board since 2019.
people.quote: Melissa B. Lora has served in several senior executive roles over her 31-year career at Taco Bell Corp.

people.name: Stephen C. Neal
people.title: Lead Director; Chairman Emeritus and Senior Counsel, Cooley LLP
people.bio: Serves as Chairman Emeritus and Senior Counsel of Cooley LLP, where he was Chief Executive Officer from 2001 to 2008. Served on Levi Strauss & Co.'s board from 2007 to 2021 and as Chairperson from 2011 to 2021.
people.quote: Stephen C. Neal serves as Chairman Emeritus and Senior Counsel of the law firm Cooley LLP

people.name: A. Brooke Seawell
people.title: Director; Venture Partner, New Enterprise Associates
people.bio: Has served as a Venture Partner at New Enterprise Associates since 2005. Previously served as Executive Vice President of NetDynamics and Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Synopsys.
people.quote: A. Brooke Seawell has served since 2005 as a Venture Partner at New Enterprise Associates

people.name: Aarti Shah
people.title: Director; Former Senior Vice President & Chief Information and Digital Officer, Eli Lilly and Company
people.bio: Worked at Eli Lilly and Company for 27 years until 2021, most recently as Senior Vice President and Chief Information and Digital Officer. Has served on Sandoz Group AG's board since 2023.
people.quote: Aarti Shah serves on the boards of various companies and non-profit organizations.

people.name: Mark A. Stevens
people.title: Director; Managing Partner, S-Cubed Capital
people.bio: Has been Managing Partner of S-Cubed Capital since 2012 and was a Managing Partner of Sequoia Capital from 1993 to 2011. Previously served on NVIDIA's board from 1993 to 2006 before returning in 2008.
people.quote: Mark A. Stevens has been the Managing Partner of S-Cubed Capital, a private family office investment firm, since 2012.
